name: An Expected Plan
description: After a thorough investigation, the Fontaine Research Institute seems to have found a lead on Nacker and the Arkhium Kinetic Core. Now, all that's left is to bring him to justice.

steps.description: Stay quiet and listen for clues
Follow Chaussivert back onto the ship
Look for Covault at The Rusty Rudder
Search ahead for the shipment's delivery point
Continue searching for the shipment's delivery point
Look for clues around the house

dialogs.content: We must resolve this quickly, Raimondo. I'm sure you're aware of the situation at the Institute right now.
If Miss Fusilier's information is reliable, then the rest won't be a problem. However, we'll need to get some help...
Now, now, what evil are you two scheming this time?
Ah, Honorary Senior Researcher! It's so good to see you!
#I won't deny the truth of your words, {NICKNAME}. Still, I believe that you will make this "evil" into good.
Hoo boy, back to the world of meaningless, endless civilities, huh?
Just point to the point. You mentioned needing help... Are you planning to send us on errands again?
#Please come over here, {NICKNAME}. I have a document I wish to show you.
A—Another explosion!? That tiny little core can explode too!?
But according to this document... Nacker is alive, and... You've almost found him?
That is incorrect. It's still possible that Mr. Nacker has apologized for his deeds with his life.
All I can say is that... our previous hypotheses are being confirmed, one after the other.
I'm going to get that guy...
Yeah! That liar caused so much trouble for everyone! And he thinks he can just walk away from it all!? Paimon's gonna give him a good bashing!
Our special investigator stationed in Lumidouce Harbor, Miss Fusilier, will assist you. I will mark her location on your map later.
Please meet Miss Fusilier there as soon as possible. She will brief you on the latest information.
Then I'll just wait here for Mr. Nacker to show himself.
Getting some rest isn't a bad idea, hehe... We'll be counting on you, eh?
#That won't do. I'm afraid we still need your help, {NICKNAME}.
Nacker has the core, and I can only imagine what kind of meka he will create to protect himself. You're the only one we can rely on to subdue him.
And... Heh, don't you want to personally teach the man who has caused you so much trouble a lesson?
My responsibilities increase with every passing day...
Heh, but your abilities must be growing steadily as well. I would expect nothing less from our Honorary Senior Researcher.
Looks like my honorary titles are about to increase again, huh?
Oh, Honorary Senior Researcher! It's so good to see you.
#Perfect timing, {NICKNAME}. You do indeed have an extraordinary sense for such honors.
I've sent someone to give your report to the Institute. In any case, I shall leave the upcoming work to you, Ms. Fusilier.
Of course, Mr. Raimondo. But about the help you mentioned...
Don't worry. When the right time comes, our Honorary Senior Researcher will...
Appear by your side.
It's great to see you so soon, Honorary Senior Researcher and the Assistant to the Honorary Senior Researcher. Oh, allow me to introduce...
This is the special investigator in charge of the stolen Arkhium Kinetic Core case, Miss Fusilier.
You are already aware of the circumstances of said case, so I won't be repeating them. In short, Mr. Nacker is the prime suspect right now.
Presently, we've discovered subtle clues in the Arkhium near Lumidouce Harbor, and... evidence that proves Mr. Nacker is still alive.
If we follow these clues to the end, I'm certain that our suspicions about Mr. Nacker will be proven.
But our main objective is still to retrieve the Arkhium Kinetic Core as soon as possible. It's an extremely unstable prototype.
If our dear Mr. Nacker's practically empty head suddenly has the bright idea of attempting to modify said core...
Maybe we'll get to enjoy another grand fireworks show somewhere...
Wh—Wh—What!? Are you trying to say that it might explode!?
Ugh... Nacker...
#{NICKNAME}! I—It seems we don't have a choice. Looks like Nacker really does deserve a good beating!
He won't get off that easily if I have anything to say about it.
I'll be counting on the two of you. I must return to the Institute.
Mr. Choiseul won't be able to deal with so many journalists for long on his own...
Even if it's just for the sake of his health, I ask that you get to the bottom of this matter as soon as possible.
I wish him good health.
Hahaha! I thank you on his behalf, then.
Raimondo leaves in a hurry...
Honorary Senior Researcher, let's act quickly. The sooner we find the culprit, the sooner we can clear Mr. Edwin's name.
Mr... Edwin?
Edwin has helped me in many ways. He was a... good person.
Nacker, on the other hand, is a despicable lowlife who used Mr. Edwin's research to harm the Institute for his own selfish interests! That's unforgivable!
It is my belief that he framed Mr. Edwin for the initial explosion in the Institute too.
After all, he is the only one who could have benefited from how things have played out up till now... and he has the Arkhium Kinetic Core.
If Nacker is really alive, then I will definitely catch him. And then, I'll make him pay for what he's done.
But I'm sure you're not here to discuss this, right, Honorary Senior Researcher?
It's almost time. Let's head down to Lumidouce Harbor. I'll brief you on the specifics once we get there.
You sound like you have a very good impression of him.
I'll buy you as much time as possible.
My responsibilities as an Honorary Senior Researcher are back to bite me again.
What trouble are you all planning to cause me now?
I've sent someone to give your report to the Institute. In any case, I shall leave the upcoming work to you, Ms. Fusilier.
Of course, Mr. Raimondo. But about the help you mentioned...
Don't worry. When the right time comes, our Honorary Senior Researcher will...
Appear by your side.
It's great to see you so soon, Honorary Senior Researcher and the Assistant to the Honorary Senior Researcher. Oh, allow me to introduce...
This is the special investigator in charge of the stolen Arkhium Kinetic Core case, Miss Fusilier.
Before I ask for your help again, please allow me to briefly explain the case of the Arkhium Kinetic Core's theft.
...And some other key information.
Raimondo briefly explains why the Fontaine Research Institute initially identified Nacker as the prime suspect.
An intense surge of Arkhium energy would have filled the Central Laboratory after the explosion, so only professionals could've engaged in work there for any length of time.

And the timing of the Experimental Field Generator's activation and attack was too much of a coincidence. According to Raimondo, the suspect must be a senior researcher linked to the research, and subsequent examinations and reenactments of the events have borne this theory out...

The only people capable of this in Fontaine Research Institute are Raimondo, Nacker, and Edwin, the last of whom passed away during the explosion. Raimondo mentions that he too is under internal review... and it sounds like a huge pain...

However, locating the Core as soon as possible still remains your main objective... The unstable prototype may go out of control at any moment and release a surge of Arkhium that would affect everything around it...
Hey! Doesn't that mean it might explode again at any moment!?
Ugh... Nacker...
#{NICKNAME}! I—It seems we don't have a choice. Looks like Nacker really does deserve a good beating!
He won't get off that easily if I have anything to say about it.
I'll be counting on the two of you. I must return to the Institute.
Mr. Choiseul won't be able to deal with so many journalists for long on his own...
Even if it's just for the sake of his health, I ask that you get to the bottom of this matter as soon as possible.
I wish him good health.
Hahaha! I thank you on his behalf, then.
Raimondo leaves in a hurry...
Honorary Senior Researcher, let's act quickly. The sooner we find the culprit, the sooner we can clear Mr. Edwin's name.
Mr... Edwin?
Edwin has helped me in many ways. He was a... good person.
Nacker, on the other hand, is a despicable lowlife who used Mr. Edwin's research to harm the Institute for his own selfish interests! That's unforgivable!
It is my belief that he framed Mr. Edwin for the initial explosion in the Institute too.
After all, he is the only one who could have benefited from how things have played out up till now... and he has the Arkhium Kinetic Core.
If Nacker is really alive, then I will definitely catch him. And then, I'll make him pay for what he's done.
But I'm sure you're not here to discuss this, right, Honorary Senior Researcher?
It's almost time. Let's head down to Lumidouce Harbor. I'll brief you on the specifics once we get there.
You sound like you have a very good impression of him.
I'll buy you as much time as possible.
My responsibilities as an Honorary Senior Researcher are back to bite me again.
Ugh, I just hope it doesn't blow us all sky-high...
What trouble are you all planning to cause me now?
What are we doing here? We look like eavesdroppers...
Well, we are here to be eavesdroppers. But I think we have to wait a little longer... Let's get behind those shrubs for now.
You wait for some time behind in the shrubbery...
Look over there. Those are the people we're waiting for.
According to my investigation, they're reselling a batch of goods linked to the Fontaine Research Institute.
And this may be connected to Nacker... Let's get closer.
...Boss! There's someone over there!
W—We've been spotted!?
Mr. Chaussivert, it seems you don't know the rules. I suppose that's as far as my warnings go. Farewell.
You pretentious... Let's go! Take those snoops out!
Fine... You're good. It's my loss.
It doesn't matter who hired you to silence me. Just do as you please.
Huh? No one's trying to silence you! Actually... We're hoping you'll talk.

We're special investigators from Fontaine Research Institute. Mr. Chaussivert, we suspect that you're involved in the disappearance of our Arkhium Kinetic Core. Please cooperate with our investigation.
So the Institute seeks assistance in their investigation by hiding and eavesdropping? Why am I not surprised?
Th—That's just a necessary investigative technique. Allow me to explain...
Fusilier gives Chaussivert a detailed account of everything. He doesn't seem to fully understand her, however...
I don't understand... Lemarcq, what the devil is all of this?
I think she's trying to tell you that some idiot stole something from the Institute, and that thing might explode at any moment.
If it explodes near Lumidouce Harbor, it'll kill all the fish there and render it impassable to ships.
So they're here to get that idiot. That's what you were trying to say, right?
Your summary is correct. I guess there is someone here with brain cells to rub together, after all.
I see... So you're here to do good, then. And here I was, thinking that that blasted Loillier had sent you to silence me.
Hmph! I misunderstood you. It's my mistake, so drinks are on me next time.
Silence you? Weren't you discussing a business deal?
A deal? Hahahaha! Looks like this misunderstanding's mutual... I would never do business with trash like Loillier.
He's always with the Snezhnayans, and all he cares about is transporting Fontaine's goods to the outside for his own benefit. He's as bad as they get.
Some time ago, he came asking for my help in smuggling a person out of Fontaine on the down low.
To smuggle someone out? Could it be...!?
Yes, it could be Nacker, the one we're looking for. What happened next, Mr. Chaussivert?
Hmm. He looked to be up to no good, so I turned him down.
Is it just Paimon, or do you seem a bit... disappointed, Miss Fusilier...?
Huh? What? I—I'm not! How could I possibly hope that someone might commit a crime? No way...
Today, he came all the way to threaten me, telling me not to leak out any information regarding this incident, or else his boss Concini would personally come to teach me a lesson.
I was just about to teach HIM a lesson when Lemarcq noticed you eavesdropping, and the guy seized the chance and fled... I guess I'll just have to wait until the next time he and I meet.
So this Loillier's boss is called Concini...
Hmm... Paimon's never heard of him. C—Could he be a Fatuus?
Uh, never mind, Paimon's just joking! There's no way that everyone from Snezhnaya who we've met is a Fatuus... Hahaha...
I used to think that way, too, but I really don't know what's going on with that Concini guy from Snezhnaya.
All I know is that he's a major buyer, and he's been purchasing all kinds of goods and equipment and sending them to the harbor. I have no idea what kind of business he's involved in.
That said, since he's associating with the likes of Loillier, he's definitely no better.
Boss, this is not the place to talk. Let's head back to the ship first.
Right. You, come with me. You're looking for that "core" thing or whatever, right? I'll help you with it.
Heh? What a surprise! And I thought there was gonna be a twist.
You... You're not planning to kill us onboard and dump our bodies in the sea, are you?!
This entire Lumidouce Harbor is under my protection. Anyone causing trouble around here is my business.
If what you said is true, then I'm doing the right thing. If not, at least Lumidouce Harbor will avoid disaster. Don't you understand that at the very least?
Y—You have a point...
Enough chit-chat. You want to talk? Get on the ship and talk.
Wow... Do you own the entire ship?
Of course it's mine. Now, let's get on with business. That thing might go off at any second, right? There's not a moment to lose.
But... We don't have anything else to go on. Based on what we know so far, you run the largest underground trading operation in Lumidouce Harbor and often deal in items related to the Institute.
During our investigations at the harbor, our investigators found trace amounts of Arkhium energy reactions on some goods. We believe that Nacker may have come through here with the core...
That's why we came to you, following the trade leads, but we didn't expect to find out that...
You're not even involved in this kind of business.
Hmph! The gray market is not the same as the black market... I'm not a parasite like Loillier.
Hey! You just said you're in the gray market. Get off your high horse!
If you'd only came to me sooner... I'd have captured that Loillier guy! He said he's gonna teach me a lesson? That, I can't wait to see.
You should've given us a chance to explain, at least!
You're the one who charged at us without a word! We wanted to explain, but you didn't give us a chance to!
Bah! I said two sentences! What do you mean by "without a word"?
Loillier... Concini... I'll report their names to the Institute. But now...
Boss, sorry to intrude, but didn't Loillier say something like "there's no use for you now" earlier?
Hmph! That he did! That scoundrel even said that it's a shame how I missed out on a load of cash... I should've punched him in the face right there!
Could that mean... that he's already found someone to do his dirty work?
You mean, someone has taken the job?
Yes, and that someone may have been paid already.
So, if we can find out who just came across a sudden windfall...
As far as I know, Loillier prefers to hire poor and lazy slugs who sit around daydreaming...
Because people like that are easiest to deceive and control, right?
Well, seems like you've seen your fair share. Perhaps there are also people like that in the Institute?
Mr. Edwin once said that if you live your life seriously, you'll find that people like that are all around you.
Right, so no more naps whenever you want from now on, Paimon.
You don't have to stress that!
No worries. I know who to see first... Boss, do you remember Covault?
Sure, I remember him. He used to be the most famous drunkard working under me, but I kicked him out of the outfit because of his habit of nicking this and that.
Well... He's now a regular at The Rusty Rudder. Pitot said that he's basically there all day, buying up most of the wine...
I think we should go and have a "conversation" with him.
Wait. But we don't have any proof...
Proof? Hahaha, if Covault needs some, I'll find him some.
But before that, he has to have an honest "conversation" with me.
Helm, plot a course to The Rusty Rudder!
It's okay, Paimon. We're not rich, but we're not exactly broke either.
Don't worry, Paimon, we're no lazy slugs.
I should've come out and given all of you a beatdown.
Your mindset regarding trades is surprisingly narrow.
Hey, that's like saying "You lack creativity in your criminal activities"!
Hahaha! Well, I'm certainly not a parasite like Loillier.
*cough* *cough* A person could choke on this alcoholic reek...
There are so many drunks in here... Can we really find this Covault guy?
Don't most people go home when they've had too much to drink?
With his financial state and moral standards, "home" is a luxury he can't afford.
He has nowhere else to be except the tavern.
Just to be on the safe side, let's stay together. The people in this watering hole aren't the friendliest.
Especially you, Institute lady. Don't stray too far from me. These drunkards might try to rob you, given how fragile you seem.
Then they will have the privilege of witnessing the power of our proud creations.
Mr. Edwin instructed me on how to modify this meka. The energy beam it emits can easily incapacitate a person.
Paimon and I will try our luck over there.
Alright, let's go. I'll take the lead. Lemarcq, you watch our flanks.
Maybe he went to take a breather outside?
Then, we can only hope that he passed out somewhere in the wild and met his end.
In any case, let's at least be civil enough to go look for him.
Heheh... I'm gonna be rich... How dare you belittle me... Burp.
That's him. There's no one else in Lumidouce Harbor with a rat-face like that.
Covault! Get up!
Wh—Who are you? I'm in the money now... Don't... Don't you dare shout at me!
Oh, sure. So where did you get it? Details, if you please.
Y—You... Chaussivert!
You... It's all because I worked for you... that I missed out on making big money!
B—Boss! Chaussivert! Please forgive me, big man!
Forgive you? Well, that depends on your behavior.
Lemarcq, tie him up and take him back to the ship!
Hmm... This device sure is handy.
Hmm... Looks like Lemarcq just took care of that guy all by himself...
Boss, you're back. Looks like you were ambushed, too. That means...
Loillier has bought both Pattyn and Morgen off. Covault was to lead us into an ambush.
Sadly, they didn't expect me to be there.
Wait a second. If they were bought off by Loillier, then what about when you were talking to him...?
Hmm. That can only mean that he had that meeting so he could eliminate me. Hmph. Brutal, but that sounds like him, alright.
Then I suppose it's a good thing that you lot came out of the blue to mess with their plans.
Otherwise, given the narrow space... we might not have made it out alive.
Still, they've attacked us twice in a row now. Could they have something to hide?
Just a motley crew.
I hope you're well-rested. Pattyn and Morgen have told us everything.
How? They were all bent on killing us not so long ago...
Well, that you don't need to know, Little Miss Institute. Lemarcq, tell them.
Aye, aye. To put it simply, with their cooperation, we have learned that two shipments will be delivered to a certain location today...
Unfortunately, those two don't know the precise location. All they know is the time when the shipments will arrive at the shore.
So, more guesswork on our part.
I have an idea. We may be able to find some clues using this energy flow detector.
If that place is indeed where Nacker is hiding, then people going in and out will carry traces of Arkhium energy.
Ooh! That means that all we have to do is to use this device, and "beep beep beep" — we'll know exactly where to go!
What do you mean, "beep beep beep"? Only those obsolete relics do that! I'm using the latest, silent model.
Beeping or not, this is a good shout. No time to waste. Let's move.
About those two...
They've gone back to where all sailors come from. No need to worry about them... Anchors aweigh!
Never mind. We'll see how it goes.
Loillier, blast him... He's already paid the bulk of the payment, but he can't afford the rest!?
Chill, man. We're all underdogs here. Don't blame the messenger.
Boss, what should we do with him?
W—Wait! Stop! How much is Loillier paying you? I'll pay you the same amount!
Or, how about this: Let me live, and I'll take Loillier out and grab his money, and then we can split the cash?
There's no need for any of that. I just have a few questions for it.
Answer them to my satisfaction, you live — or your head will roll.
Roll!
Loillier hired you to get the shipments here — that's it? Did he say who they're for?
I... I don't know. All Loillier said was to leave the shipments here, and that someone else would come pick them up.
The previous two runs were exactly like that, just at different locations...
I once stayed behind to see who the buyer was, but they didn't show. Another group of people took the shipment and headed that way. I dared not linger any longer, so I took off.
So... are you satisfied?
Good enough. Get out of here. You'd better stay away from Loillier. He's up to no good.
Boss, should I follow him?
No need. Let him go and cause some trouble for Loillier. So, he said that someone would come to pick the shipments up, hmm?
Institute Lady, it's time for you to get that device of yours beeping. We need to move.
Didn't I say that this is the latest model, and it doesn't beep?
Ma'am, what should we do with him?
Wh—Why are you asking me? And, what's with the "ma'am"? I'm not part of this outfit!
Paimon, you handle him.
Sure! Heheh, just watch Paimon... Hmmm... How many strands of hair should she pull?
The readings... are high. There are clear residual energy readings from all around this house...
Nacker... Why would he go through all the trouble to build a house here?
He must have strong nerves!
The lock on this door doesn't seem too sturdy. I think I can break it open. Stand back.
Hey, don't just bash the door in! It might be someone's home... You know, that got irradiated for some reason...
If that's the case, we'll compensate them. It's your investigation, so the money should come out of the Institute, naturally.
Huh!?
What are you doing in my house?
Wow, you showed up, Nack—
Wait, you're not Nacker... But you're wearing the Institute's uniform...
You're here to deliver the supplies, aren't you? Just leave the things at the back of the house. Can't you read the note on the door?
You're...
Mr... Edwin?
How do you know me? Tsk... Did Loillier leak my name?
No matter. Just hurry and get me the supplies. The suppressor will be ready soon... Hmm? Why are you staring at me?
Paimon must be seeing things from flying too fast...
Well, well, well! Edwin Eastinghouse, come back to life, I see!
Aren't you supposed to have died in the explosion at the Institute!?
Wh—What are you talking about? Stop wasting my time. I'm in a hurry to complete my research.
I—I'm Fusilier from Section 3! You were my research advisor, and you helped me modify the Pneumousia Ray Self-Defense Device!
What Section 3? What Ray...? Oh, now I remember. You're talking about that highly inefficient radiation device, aren't you?
What was the researcher's name, again... I can't remember. Whatever the case, that device was a solo project with no real practical value...
#Wait... You must be the Honorary Senior Researcher, {NICKNAME}. Your reputation precedes you...
You know me?
Hahaha! Concini told me about what you've done, and the title you've earned.
I have to say, the title suits you well! Just look at you, all hardworking and... Ahem.
But of course, I know full well why you're here, Honorary Senior Researcher...
You must be here for that Arkhium Kinetic Core, which that slippery fish, Nacker, stole...
I apologize, but despite his lack of creativity, pedestrian research skills, and how he's been constantly messing up my facility...
We're still in the same boat, so I cannot reveal his location to you...
I hear you, sir. However, I found this map in the house that marks a certain area...
Gosh! How did you find this map... But no matter. His precise location won't be that easy to find.
You are welcome to go and look for him, but trust me, you could make five loops around the place, and you wouldn't find him. That place took us five full years to build!
I still remember that when that place was completed, I restarted five projects and rebuilt five devices. If I were still in the Institute, my salary would've quintupled...
#...So, what's happening now, {NICKNAME}?
He's monologuing...
Lemarcq... stay here and keep an eye on this guy.
Miss Institute... I mean, Miss Fusilier. This will be a dangerous trip, so why don't you give me the device? I'll handle things going forward.
No. Let's get moving. I... I want to leave!
Wow, she seems pretty upset. What happened? I thought she worshipped Edwin...?
...Let's catch up.
Good luck. You will never find him! Five rounds, you hear!?
If you keep this up for five more seconds, I'm gonna punch you five times.
Edwin didn't even notice her.
Something must've triggered his inner Institute scientist.
Looks like you didn't quite get blown away far enough.
Oh no, the Institute is gonna get blown up again...
Or he took it from someone else.
Wh—Who are you? What are you doing here!?
Tsk. You've found me. You've got a keen nose.
We'll leave the thinking to you, Miss Institute Lady. You're the brains, and we're the brawn, after all.
Huh...? Hey! Wait! What do you mean by that?
#Lemarcq, {NICKNAME}, let's take them down!
So... Those three are all in league with each other?
That Concini guy is like the owner of a restaurant, getting Loillier to find a chef to cook for Nacker...
I told Loillier to beat it, so he went and found someone else to work for him... And then, he wanted to silence me...
Hmm, it feels like someone who messed up trying to cover their own mistake.
Huh, I see! Well, that certainly does sound like the right amount of trashy for Loillier! You may be little, but you're quite brainy, you know?
Hey, you can keep the first part of the sentence to yourself! Anyway, now we're sure that Nacker is in Lumidouce Harbor, and we've narrowed down the search area by quite a bit.
(But things are never that simple, are they...)
Ahem... Boss, we better interrogate them to see if they have any useful information.
Hm, good idea. Pattyn, you know the rules, yes?
...I'm at your disposal, Mr. Chaussivert.
Good. At least you accept the consequences of your own actions. Lemarcq, tie him and Morgen up real good.
Go to your cabins and rest. And remember to put on some earplugs... Let's just say that this won't be a silent night.

After some contemplation, you decide to sit down and rest. In the middle of the night, you are awakened by strange muffled noises and the sound of something heavy falling into the water outside of your cabin. Did something or someone fall into the water? Should you go help? Wait. Chaussivert warned you that this will not be a silent night...

You walk to the door and grab the handle. The commotion outside has quieted down by now, and only the muffled sound of waves hesitantly lapping against the hull remains as you stand hesitantly before the door. What awaits outside? A question? An answer? Regardless, with just a twist of your wrist, you can verify... certain thoughts of yours, can't you?
You hesitate. Despite already having the answer, you still want to ask for Fusilier's opinion. You turn around and see how Fusilier is trying to cover her ears, pretending to be fast asleep.
In the end, you suppress your and Paimon's curiosity and decide to not investigate. You just hope that this night will pass quickly...
Have you seen a guy called Covault?
Sure. He just bought another round for everyone before stumbling out the door.
Humph... I wonder where he got all that money.
Drink up! More... Heheheh... Another Bulle Fruit... Put it... on my tab...
Covault, time to pay up!
Who... Who's that? Who's... Covault!? Ah, move aside!
Uh, no... I'm not Covault...
No... It's not my fault... I didn't want this... It's not me...
Covault, you're in trouble!
You... Oh. You're not here for me? Great... I didn't do anything wrong... Forgive me! I'm trying... I'll do better... *sobs*
More... more! Who's drinking with me? You... You! You drink with me!
Covault, cut it with the drinking!
Who... Who? Never heard of him! You drink? You no drink? Whatever... I drink!
Romaritime Flower... Romaritime... Flower... Heheheh...
What are you saying, Covault?
I... I'm talking to... the Romaritime Flower... Who's Covault?
You... You're also Romaritime Flower? What a... coincidence! Hoohoohoo...
Wait. Now that we've gone far enough, what does your device say, Little Miss Institute?
No reaction... at all. There is no residual Arkhium energy here.
Strange. I've already tuned its sensitivity up to max, and Arkhium energy flow doesn't dissipate that easily...
This prototype was made by Mr. Edwin himself... There's no way it doesn't work...
Huh? H—How come they... and those meka behind them...
I knew it. Pattyn, how much did Loillier promise you?
An amount I'd never earn slaving under you in a lifetime. It's nothing personal, Chaussivert. But I have mouths to feed.
Don't you feel dirty getting mixed up with the likes of Loillier, taking his money like that?
Hehehe... Boss, we all roll in the same mud puddle. The money we earn? It's never clean.
You're the only one riding your high horse, saying "this business is no good, that business harms people," like you're some kinda saint.
In the end, you earn no money and win no people. Only a fool like Lemarcq would stay loyal to you.
We've sailed together for a long time. I'm sure Morgen will make his death painless.

The person in charge right now should be Cassigneul... With a woman like her around, there's no way I'd ever do business in Lumidouce Harbor.

And the person must be Nacker.

Paimon's gonna give him a good bashing...
